experiment: Four-family Anthropic comparison after CUDA coverage and SOL90 tuning
scope: A100 BF16 public-module inference; eleven variants at L128/384/768; not training, isolated kernels, or whole-model latency

protocol.timing_order: alternating on the same GPU/process for each pair
protocol.speedup: median of paired Anthropic latency / MiniWorld latency ratios; above 1 favors MiniWorld

limitations: A100 connected module inference only; no equivalent four-family A100 full-training comparison is established. Upstream backward leaves use separate contracts.
This compares the connected qualified Anthropic implementations, not an exhaustive search over upstream variants.
SOL90 remains unachieved; latency ratios do not measure SOL.
Each pair shares a GPU; different cells may use different GPUs and clock states. Small speed differences are treated as parity.
launch_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -uo pipefail
status=0
for family in "$@"; do
  for length in 128 384 768; do
    python -u benchmarks/runners/compare_anthropic_a100.py --family "$family" --length "$length" --output "/home/psk6950/miniworld-engine-scratch/codex_anthropic_post_sol90/${family}_${length}.json" || status=1
  done
done
exit "$status"

import csv
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/home/psk6950/practice/miniworld-engine')
scratch = Path('/home/psk6950/miniworld-engine-scratch/codex_anthropic_post_sol90')
families = ['dit_token', 'conditioned_transition', 'trimul', 'trimul_incoming', 'trimul_bidir', 'triattn', 'triattn_ending', 'triattn_bidir_sa', 'triattn_bias_start', 'triattn_bias_end', 'triattn_bidir_bias']
rows = [json.loads((scratch / f'{family}_{length}.json').read_text()) for family in families for length in (128, 384, 768)]
assert len(rows) == 33
for row in rows:
    assert row['status'] == 'ok', row
    assert row['selection']['anthropic'] and not row['selection']['miniworld']
    assert row['miniworld_anthropic_override'] is False
    assert row['rounds'] == 9 and row['graph_batch'] == 8
    for impl in ('miniworld', 'anthropic'):
        assert row['accuracy'][impl]['finite']
        assert row['accuracy'][impl]['relative_frobenius'] < .04
        assert row['accuracy'][impl]['update_relative_frobenius'] < .08
        assert len(row['times_ms'][impl]['samples']) == 9
        assert row['times_ms'][impl]['min'] > 0
hashes = {}
for line in (scratch / 'source-start.sha256').read_text().splitlines():
    digest, name = line.split('  ', 1)
    assert hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest, f'Source changed during measurement: {name}'
    hashes[name] = digest
summary = {
    'cells': len(rows),
    'miniworld_leads_above_1_05': sum(r['speedup_miniworld'] > 1.05 for r in rows),
    'within_0_95_to_1_05': sum(.95 <= r['speedup_miniworld'] <= 1.05 for r in rows),
    'anthropic_leads_below_0_95': sum(r['speedup_miniworld'] < .95 for r in rows),
    'geometric_mean_speedup': math.exp(sum(math.log(r['speedup_miniworld']) for r in rows) / len(rows)),
    'minimum_speedup': min(r['speedup_miniworld'] for r in rows),
    'maximum_speedup': max(r['speedup_miniworld'] for r in rows),
    'maximum_output_relative_error': {impl: max(r['accuracy'][impl]['relative_frobenius'] for r in rows) for impl in ('miniworld', 'anthropic')},
    'maximum_update_relative_error': {impl: max(r['accuracy'][impl]['update_relative_frobenius'] for r in rows) for impl in ('miniworld', 'anthropic')},
}
report = {
    'experiment': 'Four-family Anthropic comparison after CUDA coverage and SOL90 tuning',
    'date': '2026-10-04',
    'status': 'ok',
    'scope': 'A100 BF16 public-module inference; eleven variants at L128/384/768; not training, isolated kernels, or whole-model latency',
    'protocol': {'same_weights_inputs': True, 'weights': 'nonzero randomized', 'reference': 'FP32 PyTorch', 'tf32': False, 'compile': False, 'cuda_graph': True, 'rounds': 9, 'graph_batch': 8, 'timing_order': 'alternating on the same GPU/process for each pair', 'speedup': 'median of paired Anthropic latency / MiniWorld latency ratios; above 1 favors MiniWorld', 'parity_band': [.95, 1.05], 'mask': 'every seventh key excluded', 'triangle_geometry': 'B1,L,L,C128; attention H4', 'token_dit_geometry': 'A2,B1,L,D768; shared cond384; pair128; H16', 'conditioned_transition_geometry': 'A2,B1,L,D128; shared cond128', 'qualified_connected_rows_only': True},
    'limitations': ['A100 connected module inference only; no equivalent four-family A100 full-training comparison is established. Upstream backward leaves use separate contracts.', 'This compares the connected qualified Anthropic implementations, not an exhaustive search over upstream variants.', 'SOL90 remains unachieved; latency ratios do not measure SOL.', 'Each pair shares a GPU; different cells may use different GPUs and clock states. Small speed differences are treated as parity.'],
    'summary': summary,
    'source_sha256': hashes,
    'launch_script': (scratch / 'run_group.sh').read_text(),
    'aggregation_script': Path(__file__).read_text(),
    'runner_source': (root / 'benchmarks/runners/compare_anthropic_a100.py').read_text(),
    'results': rows,
}
out = root / 'docs/gpus/a100/anthropic-post-sol90-20261004'
out.with_suffix('.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
with out.with_suffix('.csv').open('w') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['family', 'length', 'miniworld_ms', 'anthropic_ms', 'paired_speedup_miniworld', 'paired_ratio_min', 'paired_ratio_max', 'band', 'slurm_job'])
    for r in rows:
        ratio = r['speedup_miniworld']
        writer.writerow([r['family'], r['length'], r['times_ms']['miniworld']['median'], r['times_ms']['anthropic']['median'], ratio, *r['paired_ratio_min_max'], 'miniworld' if ratio > 1.05 else 'anthropic' if ratio < .95 else 'parity', r['hardware']['slurm_job']])
print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
for family in families:
    cells = [r for r in rows if r['family'] == family]
    print(f"{family}: " + ' | '.join(f"L{r['length']} {r['speedup_miniworld']:.3f}x ({r['times_ms']['miniworld']['median']:.6f}/{r['times_ms']['anthropic']['median']:.6f}ms) range={r['paired_ratio_min_max']}" for r in cells))
print('MiniWorld Triton-labelled profiler names:', {r['family'] + str(r['length']): [n for n in r['gpu_kernel_names']['miniworld'] if 'triton' in n.lower()] for r in rows if any('triton' in n.lower() for n in r['gpu_kernel_names']['miniworld'])})
